stepExplanation: d sin(theta) = n lambda. For n=1: sin(theta) = lambda/d = (550 x 10^-9)/(2 x 10^-6) = 0.275. theta = arcsin(0.275) = 15.96 degrees
stepBody: Now use the grating equation d sin(theta) = n lambda for the first order (n=1). Calculate theta in degrees. (lambda = 550 nm = 550 x 10^-9 m)
